charge_port.notes: Estimated: Audi says the Q4 e-tron cannot use its NACS DC adapter, and Audi EVs lack a NACS port (electrive, InsideEVs 2025-09-08); no NACS Q4 is reported for 2022-2026.

supercharger_access.notes: Audi (quoted by electrive 2025-09-08): "The Audi Q4 e-tron cannot currently use the Audi NACS DC charging adapter or the Tesla NACS Partner Supercharger network"; InsideEVs: Q4 excluded, no timeline. No later announcement found (not found, not confirmed absent).

20-inch 10-Spoke-Star-Aero wheels come in the S line Plus Package (option), per the same page.
